title.zh: 复利与贴现 · 时间是钱的形状
title.en: Compound Interest & Discounting · Time Is the Shape of Money

desc.zh: 利息也生利息，钱就按倍数生长；反过来，未来的钱折成今天的价值，就是贴现。
desc.en: When interest earns interest, money grows by multiples; run it backwards and a future amount is worth less today, which is discounting.
